# Business Development Representative

Job Posted One Month AgoPosted One Month Ago

5 Locations


Remote or Hybrid

60K-67K Annually

Junior

Fintech • Information Technology • Security

The Role

Conduct account research, identify decision-makers, and engage prospects by phone, email, LinkedIn, and industry events. Qualify inbound leads, understand prospect needs, prepare meetings for account executives, and book sales meetings. The role includes structured sales training, coaching, and ongoing learning about financial crime, compliance, and regtech.

Summary Generated by Built In

**_Start your tech sales career with people who actually want to teach you._**

We’re hiring early-career folks who are curious, coachable, and ready to learn how modern enterprise sales really works. You don’t need a sales background — you need to be sharp, willing to pick up the phone, and excited to build something. We’ll handle the rest.

**The role, in plain terms**

You’ll be the first person from ComplyAdvantage that a potential customer talks to. That means researching companies, figuring out who the right person to reach is, and then actually reaching out — by phone, email, LinkedIn, or in person at industry events — to book a meeting with one of our account executives. It’s the front door of the sales process, and it matters.

It’s also the role where most great enterprise sales careers begin.

**What your day looks like**

You’ll spend your time researching accounts and forming a real point of view on what’s happening in their world, then reaching out to senior decision-makers at companies. You’ll work inbound leads that come in, dig into what those prospects actually need, and prep meetings so your account executives walk in ready. You’ll join industry events, build a personal brand on LinkedIn, and get smarter about financial crime, compliance, and regtech every single week.

**What we’ll teach you**

We’ve built a Go-To-Market team that takes training seriously — not as a one-week onboarding then sink-or-swim, but as an ongoing thing. You’ll learn a structured sales playbook that’s been refined over years, get coaching from experienced reps and managers, and build genuine expertise in a complex, interesting industry. The BDRs who do well here move into Account Executive, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations roles. We want this to be your launchpad.

**You might be a great fit if**

You’re naturally curious and like understanding how things work. You’re not afraid to start a conversation with someone senior — or you’re willing to get comfortable with it. You take feedback well and actually apply it. You want to be good at something hard, and you’re patient enough to put in the reps. A background in sales isn’t required — strong candidates have come from hospitality, retail, campus leadership, athletics, customer service, internships, and plenty of other places.

**Basic qualifications**

- At least one (1) year of work experience in a sales, customer-facing, or professional role. Internships, part-time jobs, on-campus leadership roles, hospitality, retail, and customer service all count.
- Must be legally authorized to work in the US without current or future sponsorship.

**What’s in it for you?**

- Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building
- Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best
- Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development
- Budget to set up your home office upon joining
- Parental leave and childcare benefits
- Life Insurance to protect your loved ones
- Medical (100%), Dental (90%), and Vision (80%) contribution
- Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to allow you to use tax free dollars for healthcare or day care related expenses
- 401k Contribution
- Financial Perks (Financial Advice, PerkSpot discounts, Pet Insurance discounts, Travel assistance)
- Pre-Tax transit benefits

**Ready?**

If you’ve read this far and something in it clicked, apply. We’d rather hear from someone who’s curious and a little nervous than someone who’s perfectly polished.

_The base salary range for this role is $60,000 to $67,000 + commission, equity, and US benefits. The actual pay may vary based on factors such as location, experience, and skills._

**About us:**

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime.

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.

## What We Do

At ComplyAdvantage, we believe that compliance doesn’t have to be painful. Businesses need real-time financial crime insight to put them in control.

We enable you to understand the real risk of who you're doing business with, through the world's only global, real-time risk database of people and companies. We actively identify tens of thousands of risk events from millions of structured and unstructured data points - every single day.

Our suite of configurable cloud services integrates seamlessly to help automate and reduce the frustration of complying with Sanctions, AML and CTF regulations.
